summary_en: This study tests ONC-PluReceptor NK cell therapy, combined with epcoritamab and tafasitamab, in people with recurrent or refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. The NK cells are given by injection, and the dose and schedule are not stated. The study aims to learn whether the treatment can help control the lymphoma and to study its safety; it is a Phase 1/2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba la terapia con células NK ONC-PluReceptor, combinada con epcoritamab y tafasitamab, en personas con linfoma no Hodgkin de células B recurrente o refractario. Las células NK se administran por inyección; la dosis y el calendario no se indican. El estudio busca saber si el tratamiento puede ayudar a controlar el linfoma y estudiar su seguridad; es un estudio de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 80 years with relapsed or refractory DLBCL or follicular lymphoma.
Failed at least 2 prior lines of therapy, or had an autologous or allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Prior CAR-T failure, or not eligible for CAR-T cells.
Tumor biopsy positive for CD19 or CD20 at 1% or more by immunohistochemistry or flow cytometry.
Karnofsky performance status of 60% or higher.
not_for: Lymphoma in complete remission with no measurable disease sites.
Active hepatitis B or C, or HIV infection.
Systemic steroid therapy or immunosuppressive therapy at enrollment.
Anti-cancer treatment within the prior 2 weeks.
